content: Rubɛni u sɑ̃ɑwɑ Isirelin bii ɡbiikoo. N deemɑ Rubɛni wi, u kɑ win tundon kurɔ kpunɑ. Mɑ bɑ win yerumɑru mwɑ bɑ win wɔnɔ Yosɛfun bibu wɛ̃. Yen sɔ̃nɑ bɑ ǹ win bwese kɛrɑn tɔmbun yĩsɑ tireru doke yerumɑrun swɑɑ sɔɔ.
Isirelin bii be sɔɔ, Yudɑwɑ u dɑm bo. Win bwese kɛrɑn diyɑ kpɑro u yɑrɑ. Adɑmɑ Yosɛfun bibɑ bɑ yerumɑru wɛ̃.
Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Rubɛni, Isirelin bii ɡbiikoon bibu, berɑ Enɔku, kɑ Pɑɑlu, kɑ Hɛsironi, kɑ Kɑɑmi.
Yoɛliwɑ u Semɑyɑ mɑrɑ. Mɑ Semɑyɑ u seewɑ u Gɔɡu mɑrɑ. Mɑ Gɔɡu u mɑɑ seewɑ u Simɛi mɑrɑ.
Ye Simɛi u seewɑ, mɑ u Misee mɑrɑ, mɑ Misee u seewɑ u Reɑyɑ mɑrɑ.
Mɑ Reɑyɑ u seewɑ u Bɑɑli mɑrɑ. Mɑ Bɑɑli u seewɑ u Beerɑ mɑrɑ. Wiyɑ u sɑ̃ɑ Rubɛnibɑn wiruɡii. Wiyɑ Tiɡilɑti Pilesɛɛ, Asirin sinɑ boko u yoru mwɑ.
Beerɑn tɔmbun yĩsɑ wee nɡe mɛ bɑ kɑ bu tireru doke yɛnu kɑ yɛnu, bwese kɛrɑ kɑ bwese kɛrɑ, kɑ nɡe mɛ bɑ kɑ kerɑnɛ. Yeyɛliwɑ u sɑ̃ɑ ben ɡbiikoo. Mɑ Sɑkɑri u swĩi,
kɑ Belɑ, Asɑsin bii, Semɑn debubu, Yoɛlin sikɑdobu. Belɑn temɑ Aroɛɛn di, n kɑ dɑ ɡuu te bɑ mɔ̀ Nɛboɔ, sere kɑ Bɑɑli Mɛɔniɔ.
Sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ, win tem mu wɑ̃ɑwɑ sɑɑ Efɑrɑtin dɑɑrun di sere n kɑ dɑ ɡbɑburun duu yerɔ. Domi ben yɑɑ sɑbenu nu dɑbiɑ Gɑlɑdin tem mɛ sɔɔ.
Sɔɔlu, sinɑ bokon wɑɑti sɔɔ, bɑ kɑ Hɑɡɑrenibɑ tɑbu kuɑ bɑ kɑmiɑ. Mɑ bɑ sinɑ ben wɑ̃ɑ yenɔ Gɑlɑdin sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yerun berɑ ɡiɑ kpuro.
Gɑdin bwese kɛrɑn tɔmbu
Gɑdin bwese kɛrɑn tɔmbu bɑ sinɑ Rubɛnibɑn deedeeru sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑ, Bɑsɑnin temɔ sere n kɑ ɡirɑri Sɑlikɑɔ sɔɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ.
Yoɛlin bwese kɛrɑ yɑ kpɑ̃ɑru bo. Mɑ Sɑfɑmuɡiɑ yɑ sɑ̃ɑ yiruse. Mɑ Yɑnɑiɡiɑ kɑ Sɑfɑtiɡiɑ yɑ wɑ̃ɑ Bɑsɑniɔ.
Bwese kɛri nɔɔbɑ yiru ɡɛɛ mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ. Yiyɑ Mikɑɛlin bwese kɛrɑ, kɑ Mɛsulɑmuɡiɑ, kɑ Sebɑɡiɑ, kɑ Yorɑiɡiɑ, kɑ Yɑkɑniɡiɑ, kɑ Siɑɡiɑ, kɑ sere Ebɛɛɡiɑ.
Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Abihɑilin bibun bweseru, berɑ Huri, kɑ Yɑroɑsi, kɑ Gɑlɑdi, kɑ Mikɑɛli, kɑ Yɛsisɑi, kɑ Yɑdo, kɑ sere Busi.
Aki, Abudiɛlin bii, Gunin debubuwɑ u sɑ̃ɑ ben wiruɡii.
Gɑdin bwese kɛrin tɔn be, bɑ wɑ̃ɑwɑ Gɑlɑdiɔ kɑ Bɑsɑniɔ kɑ yen bɑru kpɑɑnɔ kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenɔ sɑɑ Sɑronin di n kɑ dɑ yen nɔɔ burɑ yenɔ.
Bɑ ben bwese kɛri yi kpuro tireru dokewɑ nɡe mɛ yi kɑ swĩinɛ, Yotɑmu Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko kɑ Yeroboɑmu Isirelibɑn sinɑ bokon wɑɑti sɔɔ.

Rubɛnin bwese kɛrɑ kɑ Gɑdiɡiɑ kɑ sere Mɑnɑsen bwese kɛrɑn bɔnu bɑ tɑbu durɔ dɑmɡibu mɔ be bɑ koo kpĩ bu tɛrɛru kɑ tɑkobi nɛnɛ kpɑ bu tɛndu to. Bɑ mɑɑ tɑbu tobu yɛ̃ ɡem ɡem. Ben ɡeerɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ weeru kɑ nnɛ kɑ tɔmbu nɑtɑ kɑ wunɔbu kɑ wɑtɑ (44.760). Bɑ mɑɑ sɔɔru sɑ̃ɑ bu kɑ tɑbu to.
Mɑ bɑ Hɑɡɑrenibɑ kɑ Yeturiɡibu, kɑ Nɑfisiɡibu, kɑ Nɔdɑbuɡibu tɑbu wɔri.
Sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ tɑɑ bi mɔ̀, bɑ Yinni Gusunɔ somiru kɑnɑ domi bɑ ben nɑɑnɛ doke wi sɔɔ. Mɑ bɑ Hɑɡɑreniɡii be, kɑ be bɑ bu somiru nɑ kɑmiɑ.

Mɑ bɑ ben yɑɑ sɑbenu mwɛɛrɑ. Niyɑ yooyoosu nɔrɔbun subɑ weerɑɑkuru (50.000) kɑ yɑ̃ɑ ninu nɔrɔbun subɑ ɡoobu kɑ weerɑɑkuru (250.000) kɑ kɛtɛkunu nɔrɔbun subɑ yiru (2.000) kɑ sere tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ wunɔbu (100.000).
Tɔn be bɑ ɡo tɑɑ bi sɔɔ, bɑ dɑbi. Domi Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u derɑ n koorɑ mɛ. Mɑ bɑ sinɑ tem mi sere n kɑ turɑ sɑɑ ye bɑ bu yoru mwɑ bɑ kɑ doonɑ.
Mɑnɑsen bwese kɛrɑ
Mɑnɑsen bwese kɛrɑn sukum mu nɑ mu sinɑwɑ tem mɛ mu wɑ̃ɑ Bɑsɑniɔ, n kɑ dɑ Bɑɑli Hɛɛmɔɔwɔ kɑ Seniriɔ, sere kɑ ɡuu te bɑ mɔ̀ Hɛɛmɔɔ. Tɔn be, bɑ dɑbi.
Ben wiruɡibun yĩsɑ wee. Efɛɛ, kɑ Yisei, kɑ Eliɛli, kɑ Asiriɛli, kɑ Yeremi, kɑ Hodɑfiɑ, kɑ Yɑdiɛli. Bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔn durɔ wɔruɡɔbɑ, mɑ bɑ yĩsiru yɑrɑ.
Adɑmɑ bɑ Gusunɔ ben bɑɑbɑbɑn Yinni torɑri. Bɑ bwese tukunun bũnu sɑ̃wɑ ni u rɑɑ kɑm koosiɑ.

Yen sɔ̃nɑ wi, Gusunɔ Isirelibɑn Yinni u derɑ Asirin sinɑm beni, Pulu kɑ Tiɡilɑti Pilesɛɛ bɑ Rubɛnibɑ, kɑ Gɑdibɑ, kɑ Mɑnɑsen bwese kɛrɑn sukum yoru mwɛɛrɑ bɑ kɑ dɑ Sɑlɑsiɔ, kɑ Sɑboriɔ, kɑ Hɑrɑɔ, kɑ sere Gosɑnin dɑɑrun bɔkuɔ. Miyɑ bɑ wɑ̃ɑ sere kɑ ɡisɔ.
Lefi be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ yɑ̃ku kowo
tɔnwerobu
Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Lefin bibu, berɑ Gɛɛsɔni, kɑ Kehɑti, kɑ Mɛrɑri.
Ye Kehɑti u seewɑ, mɑ u Amurɑmu kɑ Yisehɑri kɑ Heboroni kɑ Usiɛli mɑrɑ.
Ye Amurɑmu u seewɑ, mɑ u Aroni kɑ Mɔwisi kɑ Mɑriɑmu mɑrɑ. Mɑ Aroni u mɑɑ seewɑ u Nɑdɑbu kɑ Abihu kɑ Eleɑsɑɑ kɑ Itɑmɑɑ mɑrɑ.
Ye Eleɑsɑɑ u seewɑ, mɑ u Finɛɛsi mɑrɑ. Mɑ Finɛɛsi u seewɑ u Abisuɑ mɑrɑ.
Ye Abisuɑ u seewɑ mɑ u Buki mɑrɑ. Mɑ Buki u seewɑ u Usi mɑrɑ.
Ye Usi u seewɑ, mɑ u Serɑyɑ mɑrɑ. Mɑ Serɑyɑ u seewɑ u Mɛrɑyɔtu mɑrɑ.
Ye Mɛrɑyɔtu u seewɑ, mɑ u Amɑriɑ mɑrɑ. Mɑ Amɑriɑ u seewɑ u Akitubu mɑrɑ.
Ye Akitubu u seewɑ, mɑ u Sɑdɔku mɑrɑ. Mɑ Sɑdɔku u seewɑ u Akimɑsi mɑrɑ.
Ye Akimɑsi u seewɑ, mɑ u Asɑriɑ mɑrɑ. Mɑ Asɑriɑ u seewɑ u Yokɑnɑni mɑrɑ.
Ye Yokɑnɑni u seewɑ, mɑ u Asɑriɑ mɑrɑ. Asɑriɑ wiyɑ u rɑ yɑ̃kunu ko Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ te Sɑlomɔɔ u bɑnɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ.
Ye Asɑriɑ wi, u seewɑ, mɑ u Amɑriɑ mɑrɑ. Mɑ Amɑriɑ u seewɑ u Akitubu mɑrɑ.
Ye Akitubu u seewɑ mɑ u Sɑdɔku mɑrɑ. Mɑ Sɑdɔku u seewɑ u Sɑlumu mɑrɑ.
Ye Sɑlumu u seewɑ, mɑ u Hilikiyɑ mɑrɑ. Mɑ Hilikiyɑ u seewɑ u Asɑriɑ mɑrɑ.
Ye Asɑriɑ u seewɑ mɑ u Serɑyɑ mɑrɑ. Mɑ Serɑyɑ u seewɑ u Yosɑdɑki mɑrɑ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u derɑ Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑ u Yudɑbɑ kɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɡibu yoru mwɛɛrɑ u kɑ doonɑ, kɑ Yosɑdɑki wi sɑnnɑ mi.
